responsibility: This file implements the generic read/write indirection layer used by higher mc-boot runtime code. It maintains small stacks of current input and output procedure callbacks, initializes them to IO_Read and IO_Write, and provides push/pop and query operations so modules can temporarily redirect character input or output, making it the runtime's pluggable stream-dispatch layer above the concrete IO module.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation side of GStdIO: it owns the input/output callback stacks, initializes them to IO_Read and IO_Write, and performs push/pop/current dispatch, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStdIO.h only defines the callback record types and function declarations.
